provenance.prediction_lineage: Genuine fixed-origin chronological OOF generated retrospectively on 8 November 2026; issue times are simulated historical origins, not archived real-time forecast vintages.
provenance.availability_assumption: PM interval end is a proxy for availability; first-publication times are unverified. P_fix archive series policy uses supplied 2024 history.
provenance.historical_confirmation_limit: Later chronological origins were previously inspected by analysts; this is not independent calibration.
provenance.live_lead_comparability: OOF issue equals PM cutoff (193-240h issue lead). Current live issue is later than PM cutoff; matching PM-information age does not establish matching issue-lead calibration.

calibration.reason: No independently validated decision probability/interval method; descriptive paired errors only.

scenario.definition: All matched OOF origins, stations and both target days. Rank every complete forecast window before inspecting actual outcomes; retain cases with missing outcomes.
